summary.intent: Get the first public release (0.2.0) of the caliper / oxc-react-docgen project published to crates.io and npm via callisto, then continue with extraction-quality improvements (string-default quotes, curated-mode React attributes, Mantine wrapper props) and open a PR for the user's fixed LLM hooks.
summary.outcome: Release prep PR #33 and a series of CI fixes (#36, #37, #38) were merged or opened, but the 0.2.0 publish is only half done: oxc-react-docgen-core 0.2.0 reached crates.io while execute failed on a cargo info color-parsing issue, with a fix in PR #38 pending. PRs #126-#129 were also opened for follow-up work and a chore/llm-hooks branch was pushed for the hooks PR.

repo: Local main had 8 commits never pushed to origin (AGENTS.md convention, ADR 0006, tsc-client, Entire hooks); they were cherry-picked onto the release branch. All 8 subjects already existed on origin/main under new hashes by the end.

callisto is pinned in release.yml, ci.yml and callisto.toml; moved from 0.10.0 to 0.11.0 (sha 5e8c169). The first release is forced to 0.2.0 via a minor changeset to avoid PR #22 shipping 0.1.1 and skipping the unpublished 0.1.0.
oxfmt rewrites double-quoted scoped package names in changeset frontmatter to single quotes, which callisto does not strip; scoped names must be left unquoted.
oxfmt --check on markdown flags callisto-generated CHANGELOG.md files, so release PRs failed Lint; fixed by adding **/CHANGELOG.md to ignorePatterns in .oxfmtrc.json (PR #37).
Dependabot oxfmt bumps can newly flag docs/archive/*.md files and turn Lint red on main (fixed in PR #36).

Workflow-wide CARGO_TERM_COLOR=always makes cargo info wrap the 'version:' label in ANSI escapes, so callisto 0.11.0's classify_cargo_info fails with E176 and cannot adopt an already-published crate. Fix: set CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never in the execute job (PR #38).
Callisto runs `cargo info NAME@VERSION --registry crates-io` and classifies stdout in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/provider/registry.rs.

The release-candidate job once failed to recognise the merged release PR (likely a GitHub timing race), skipping plan/build/execute; recovery is `gh workflow run release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha=<sha>`.
Test in crates/cli/src/commands/extract.rs was fragile: miette word-wraps long CI temp paths mid-directory-name, breaking substring asserts.
ADR rule: changing an ADR requires a new ADR, so the curated-mode amendment became ADR 0013.

Wildcard re-exports (`export * from`) previously found types but not functions in follow_reexports (crates/core/src/resolver/import.rs), which blocked Mantine factory callee lookup through two barrels.
Watch-mode dependency tracking needed the wrapper callee file recorded so editing the factory file re-resolves wrapper-built components; a watch test caught this.

code.finding: is_declared_at checks in follow_reexports were replaced with a declares() helper so wildcard re-exports resolve functions as well as types.
Added asserted_return_type to read the single top-level `return x as T` of a wrapper function, giving the callee's result type for resolver/callee.rs.
execute job needs CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never to override the workflow-wide 'always' so callisto can parse cargo info.

workflow: Verify publishes on the registries (npm view, cargo search, tags) rather than trusting a green workflow run; the first run was green but published nothing.
Read the tool's source at the exact tagged version; the local callisto checkout was 0.10.0 so the 0.11.0 tag had to be read via the GitHub API.
Reproducing CI failures locally by matching toolchain and environment (forced color, byte dump with od -c) pinpointed the root cause.
Back up and stash before resetting a user's main checkout (backup branch plus named stash) and avoid force-pushes by merging main instead of rebasing.
Transient proto/Node download failures in CI are resolved by `gh run rerun --failed`.

friction: Several bash calls had to be re-issued (git fetch/rebase, git commit, sed) after initial attempts apparently did not take effect or the stash was empty.
The release-candidate job skipped plan/build/execute on the first release-PR merge, requiring a manual dispatch.
execute failed repeatedly with E157/E176 after the core crate was already published, leaving the release half done.
User's merges of dependabot bumps were mistaken for release PR merges, causing confusion about what had published.
CI flakiness: install-action error on main, proto install Node download failure on #84, and a macOS signal test flake.
Corpus benchmark timings were noisy and needed hyperfine reruns to rule out regressions.
Earlier recall figures reported to the user (29% and 9%) were stale and had to be corrected.
open_items: Merge PR #38, then re-dispatch the release for source sha 71140ca619024edb3e39bd770d41193008b67d01 to publish the remaining crates and npm packages.
Report upstream the callisto 0.11.0 bug where ANSI-colored cargo info output is not parsed.
Investigate the release-candidate race that skipped plan/build/execute.
Review and merge #126-#129 (#129 CI was still running) and the chore/llm-hooks PR; the hooks PR itself had not been opened with gh pr create yet, only the branch pushed.
60 Mantine props from polymorphicFactory (conditional return type declared in the function body) need the TypeScript backend.
27 Chakra recipe variant props (size, variant) are missing; suggested as the cheapest next step.
About 7 opaque factories (createIconLoader, createIcon) remain unresolved.
--load-dependencies is planned to become the default in 0.5.0.
Stash main-checkout-cleanup-2026-10-23 and branch backup/local-main-2026-09-28 hold old local state that may be deleted later.
The release workflow's lack of CI checks on the release-PR branch (GITHUB_TOKEN pushes) was not investigated.
